svg.aria-label: The developer's October site plan for 128 Boulder Lane, with our labels. A pink line encloses everything the plan builds, in a band on the east side of the site: rows of 40 townhomes at the north end, nearest Kennel Hill Drive, then the assisted living and memory care building and its parking toward Route 128, and a driveway out to Boulder Lane at the southeast corner. West of the line are woods and wetlands, including two ponds that match the state-certified vernal pools.
svg.font-family: DM Sans, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
